messages:
Nora (CS): Heads-up: Lighthouse just uploaded their vendor risk form and flagged two outstanding asks that could impact renewal. Health bumped to yellow.
Ethan (Solutions): What are the asks?
Nora (CS): 1) Confirmation of encryption-at-rest configuration for customer data (they want specific AES-GCM key lengths and KMS flow). 2) DPA appendix: they want a shorter retention window for production logs plus explicit right-to-delete SLA.
Diego (Security): I reviewed the upload. Our infra uses AES-256-GCM by default and keys are managed via our KMS integration. We can share a config doc and key rotation cadence. They'll probably ask for BYOK; if so, that's a sales/legal decision.
Lily (Legal): For the DPA appendix, we can offer our standard retention addendum but we need to confirm whether a shorter retention (30 days) is feasible for their production logs. Also need to check deletion SLA language — standard is 30 days post-request for exported data, 90 days for backups.
Ethan (Solutions): Can we carve out logs vs. customer content? We might be able to treat application logs differently. What's the required parity for telemetry vs user data?
Diego (Security): We separate PII/PD from infra logs. If they want 30-day retention for everything, that's a bit disruptive — some of our monitoring tools rely on 90-day windows. We can propose a compromise: 30-day retention for user-generated content and 60-day for system telemetry, with an option to request immediate export & deletion for specific datasets.
Nora (CS): Lighthouse expects an answer before the renewal review next Tue. I'm proposing a 20-min triage this afternoon. ETA: can we assemble artifacts before the triage?
Diego (Security): I'll prepare: (a) encryption config snippet, (b) KMS key rotation schedule, (c) example export request flow with audit log lines.
Lily (Legal): I'll draft the DPA appendix response with two options: (1) standard addendum + 60-day telemetry compromise, (2) bespoke 30-day telemetry but with listed feature limitations. Need input from Engineering on feasibility.
Ethan (Solutions): I'll mock up a short one-pager: "Encryption & Retention options for Lighthouse" and include tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4899 created by Nora (CS) -> status: triage_scheduled
Nora (CS): Triage scheduled 3pm PT. Invite sent to Lighthouse security and their buyer.
Diego (Security): Uploaded encryption config and sample audit lines to CS-4899. Link: https://rwd-internal/cs/CS-4899/evidence
Lily (Legal): Draft appendix uploaded as a comment in the ticket for review.
Ethan (Solutions): One-pager attached.
Nora (CS): Quick runbook: 1) Diego finalizes artifacts before 2:30pm 2) Lily finalizes legal options by EOD 3) Ethan prepares the one-pager and slides for renewal meeting 4) I'll facilitate during the triage.
Diego (Security): On BYOK: if Lighthouse escalates, we need to flag as "sales assist" and involve infra. Noted.
Lily (Legal): If they request deletion SLA tighter than 30 days for backups, we will not agree without infra/eng signoff.
Ethan (Solutions): Also call out potential perf monitoring gaps if telemetry retention reduced. I'll list affected features in the one-pager.
Nora (CS): Great. Goal is to push health back to green before renewal. If triage uncovers blockers, we'll escalate to VP CS.
Ethan (Solutions): +1.
Diego (Security): Adding audit example lines to ticket now.
Nora (CS): Thanks team — tagging this for follow-up in CS-4899. Will post a short recap after triage. :white_check_mark:
